backup.title: Backup
backup.subtitle: Encrypted · two locations, both in India · required daily for a private limited company’s electronic books
backup.noRight: You don't have the right to see backups. Ask Admin for “Backup”.

secondAdmin.body: Restores need a second Admin to confirm, and backup alerts go to both. Add one in Users and rights.

schedule.title: Schedule
schedule.dumpValue: Every night · encrypted pg_dump + file sync
schedule.runner: The nightly copy runs on a runner hosted in India, never on GitHub-hosted runners.

where.title: Where copies are kept
where.rule: Copies may be kept only in India (Hyderabad ap-south-2, Mumbai, or an office server). The server refuses any other location.

keep.title: How long they are kept
keep.settingsHint: Retention is set by Admin in Settings (backup.daily_days, backup.monthly_months, backup.year_end_years).

tally.title: Load a Tally backup · Admin only
tally.s1: The file is stored encrypted, on servers in India.
tally.s2: It is restored in TallyPrime on the import computer, in its own folder, never over your live Tally.
tally.s3: Ledgers, stock items, vouchers and stock are read from that copy into an import batch.
tally.s4: Totals are checked against Tally: trial balance, day book count and opening bills. Every difference goes to the Bug fixer.
tally.s5: Admin approves; the load is one batch that can be undone until it is approved.
tally.note: A Tally backup opens only in TallyPrime, so the import computer needs a TallyPrime licence. XML and Excel exports load directly. Loading the same file twice is caught by Tally’s IDs.

files.title: Tally files read so far
files.caption: Import batches
files.empty: No files loaded yet. Upload a Tally export or backup on Import data.
files.noRight: Import batches are visible with the “Import data” right.

restore.title: Restore · Admin only
restore.s1: Pick a backup by date and time.
restore.s2: It is restored into a separate project first.
restore.s3: Balances and recent entries are compared with live.
restore.s4: Only then is it promoted to live, confirmed by a second Admin.
restore.note: Every restore and restore drill is recorded below and in the user log.

history.title: Backup history
history.caption: Backup and restore runs
history.empty: No backups recorded yet. Each run shows here with its time, size, location and result.
history.emptyAdmin: No backups recorded yet. Record the first backup or restore drill.

form.title: Record a backup or restore drill
form.description: What ran, where the copy is kept and how it went. Locations outside India are refused.
form.locationHelp: For example: S3 ap-south-2 Hyderabad (India), or the office server and its town (India).
form.errSize: Enter whole bytes, or leave empty.

rules.backup.outside_india: Backups may be kept only in India. Name the Indian location, e.g. “Hyderabad ap-south-2 (India)”.
